visual_description: A promotional content block with a Valentine's Day message, detailed description of a red velvet cheesecake cake, and a call-to-action button for ordering.
purpose: Engages the reader with a seasonal promotion and encourages order placement.
fingerprint: Valentine's Day promotion content cake order deadline call-to-action
rag_text: Valentine’s Day is this Saturday. Your person, your best friend, your brunch crew, or just you on the couch with a fork — everyone wants cake. Specifically, Red Velvet Cheesecake Cake: deep red layers of double-chocolate cake, tangy cheesecake filling, and cream cheese frosting. Rich, red, romantic — it’s everything a Valentine’s treat should be. Order by February 10th to lock in delivery by the 14th.
